# Dan Cruz Homes

> Large minimalist homes across the Midwest. Production-builder process, single-builder finish. 50 homes planned.

## Brand
- Builder: Dan Cruz Homes · Chicago
- Aesthetic: minimalist, large planes, quiet materials
- Process: production-builder (every home follows the same 4-step path)
- Pipeline: 3 phases, 7 → 18 → 25 homes across 10 regions

## Active builds
- 3 homes on the boards right now: West Loop Minimalist Loft, Lincoln Park ADU, Pilsen Two-Flat

## Tools
- Property Readiness Grader: https://dancruzhomes.com/grader
  - Free: 2 sections (Condition, Location)
  - $5 one-time: full 6 sections + score + verdict + print
